scope: Two fixed barrier slabs meet perimeter walls; no humans, group dynamics, forced waypoint, velocity publisher, or route around the outer ends.
criteria: Each attempt preserved. No automatic retry or unreported tuning.
Actual goal status SUCCEEDED and world XY<=.2m / yaw<=.25rad (existing independent policy).
Recorded physical robot crosses gate x=-24 from left to right; bounding circle must fit gap.
Conservative continuous-segment lower-bound distance to every fixture box minus native enclosing radius .168062484748657 must remain positive.
Native uint8 costmaps and static TF/camera bytes audited against MCAP.
No native force-contact stream; geometric certificate is not contact-force truth.
controls: Same geometry, map, native robot, radius/padding, inflation, cost scale, speeds, NavFn, goal and all other MPPI parameters; no waypoint or velocity publisher. Single fresh attempt per width; joint treatment, not parameter ablation. MPPI RNG is not fixed; the static plan seed placeholder does not seed MPPI.
